lang: Hebrew (English summary pp. 87*-88* included in the PDF)
location_note: Western Wall Plaza excavations (2005-2009), Old City of Jerusalem; no map reference. Placed by the title name Jerusalem (Z4).
notes: Iron Age inscriptions and incised marks, mostly from the 2.5 m fill deliberately heaped inside an earlier quarry on whose floor the Iron Age 'four-room' building was founded. The quarry is coded as the finds' context (choice C2). Channels named only as findspot labels in the catalogue (an Islamic-period channel; a drainage channel in Room 6) are not coded (choice C2 limit).

features.subtype: stone quarry under the Iron Age building, filled deliberately before the floors were laid
features.period: earlier than the Iron Age II building (fill with 7th c. BCE pottery)
features.quote: והושתת על קרקעית מחצבה שקדמה לו
